data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for picking, cropping, and capturing images and videos
data.what_it_does: Provides a unified API to select media from the library, take photos or record videos, crop images, and compress output. Supports iOS and Android with platform-specific permissions.
use_when: You need a single plugin that handles image/video selection and cropping across iOS and Android
You want to pre-select items, compress images, or support GIFs
avoid_when: You only target one platform and prefer the platform-specific picker
You need advanced image processing beyond cropping
strengths: All-in-one media picker with cropping and compression
Supports pre-selection, GIFs, and multiple image cropping
Active maintenance and recent bug fixes
weaknesses: No support for web or desktop
data.setup_notes: Add iOS Info.plist permissions (NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription, NSCameraUsageDescription, NSMicrophoneUsageDescription) and AndroidManifest permissions (READ/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, READ_MEDIA_IMAGES/VIDEO, CAMERA, RECORD_AUDIO). Set minSdkVersion 21 and iOS deployment target 11.0.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard Flutter image picker with similar functionality but without cropping and compression
